---
title: "Progress"
description: "Live status of every chapter as the course is written."
execute:
  freeze: false
  echo: false
---

The course is being written chapter by chapter. Each chapter goes through five agents:
a **writer**, a **web fact-checker**, then a **beginner reader** and a **veteran coach** reviewing in
parallel, and finally a **reviser** who applies both reviews. A chapter appears in the sidebar when
the reviser finishes.

```{python}
#| output: asis
import datetime, yaml
from pathlib import Path

spec = yaml.safe_load(Path("planning/chapters.yml").read_text())
rev = Path("planning/reviews")
STAGES = [("published", "✅ Published"), ("revising", "✏️ Revising after reviews"),
          ("reviewing", "🔎 Beginner + coach review"), ("factcheck", "🌐 Fact-checking"),
          ("writing", "📝 Writing"), ("queued", "⏳ Queued")]

def stage(cid, path):
    if (rev / f"{cid}.done").exists():
        return "published"
    if (rev / f"{cid}-beginner.md").exists() and (rev / f"{cid}-coach.md").exists():
        return "revising"
    if (rev / f"{cid}-factcheck.md").exists():
        return "reviewing"
    if path.exists():
        return "writing"
    return "queued"

rows, counts = [], {k: 0 for k, _ in STAGES}
for part in spec["parts"]:
    rows.append(f"\n### {part['title']}\n\n| | Chapter | Status |\n|---|---|---|")
    for c in part["chapters"]:
        path = Path("chapters") / part["dir"] / f"{c}.qmd"
        st = stage(c[:5], path)
        counts[st] += 1
        title = c[6:].replace("-", " ").capitalize()
        link = f"[{title}]({path.as_posix()})" if st == "published" else title
        rows.append(f"| {c[:5]} | {link} | {dict(STAGES)[st]} |")

total = sum(counts.values())
done = counts["published"]
now = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
print(f"**{done} of {total} chapters published** ({100 * done // total}%), updated {now}.\n")
print(" · ".join(f"{label}: {counts[k]}" for k, label in STAGES if counts[k]))
print(f'\n<progress value="{done}" max="{total}" style="width:100%;height:1.2rem"></progress>\n')
print("\n".join(rows))
```
